versions.title_at_revision: Interrelation of latching and locking systems
versions.text: Criterion: Verify that any locking system is incapable of locking or indicating it is locked unless all the latches are properly latched in the fully secured position. Standard: The latching system is independent of the locking system so that any inadvertent unlatching attempt does not cause unlocking. There is no possibility of an out of sequence door locking action producing a false indication of a locked door. There is no indication of a locked condition other than when the locking action is fully completed. Method of Compliance: Verify by analysis and demonstration that the latching system is independent of the locking system so that any inadvertent unlatching attempt will not cause unlocking. Verify by demonstration that the locking system is incapable of locking or indicating it is locked unless the latches are in the fully secured position and the locking action is completed. Verify by analysis and demonstration that the locking system is independent of the latching system and that inadvertent unlocking does not cause unlatching. Verify by analysis and demonstration that inadvertent latching system activation does not cause unlocking or unlatching with the locking system engaged. References: JSSG-2009: (Appendix I) I.3.4.9.1, I.3.4.9.4

versions.title_at_revision: Interrelation of latching and locking systems
versions.text:
Standard: Any locking system is incapable of locking or indicating it is locked unless all the latches are properly latched in the fully secured position. The latching system is independent of the locking system so that any inadvertent unlatching attempt does not cause unlocking. There is no possibility of an out of sequence door locking action producing a false indication of a locked door. There is no indication of a locked condition other than when the locking action is fully completed. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Verify by analysis that the latching system is independent of the locking system so that any inadvertent unlatching attempt will not cause unlocking. Verify by analysis that the locking system is independent of the latching system and that inadvertent unlocking does not cause unlatching. Verify by analysis that inadvertent latching system activation does not cause unlocking or unlatching with the locking system engaged. Demonstration.
  (1) Conduct a demonstration to verify that the latching system is independent of the locking system so that any inadvertent unlatching attempt will not cause unlocking. Conduct a demonstration to verify that the locking system is incapable of locking or indicating it is locked unless the latches are in a fully secured position and the locking action is completed. Conduct a demonstration to verify that the locking system is independent of the latching system and that inadvertent unlocking does not cause unlatching. Conduct a demonstration to verify that inadvertent latching system activation does not cause unlocking or unlatching with the locking system engaged.
